offer.title: Amicci’s Pane Rotundo and Classic Dinner Entrées
offer.text: Pane Rotundo is Amicci’s garlic-buttered Italian bread topped with shrimp in creamy scampi sauce. The classic dinner menu includes pasta, chicken and vegetarian dishes, with optional house or Caesar salad for $4.

sections.title: Menu selection
sections.text: The selected scope is The Pane Rotundo and classic dinner entrées from the dinner menu.
bullets: The Pane Rotundo is a round Italian loaf brushed with garlic butter, toasted, and topped with shrimp in creamy scampi sauce.
Classic dinner entrées include Chicken Parmigiana, House Gnocchi, Penne Amicci, and Spaghetti & Meatballs, among other listed options.
A side Amicci’s House or Caesar Salad may be added to any entrée for $4.

sections.title: Practical information
sections.text: Amicci’s lists its location as 231 S. High Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202. Contact the restaurant directly for current menu and service details.
bullets: Dinner hours listed: Monday–Thursday and Sunday, 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Friday–Saturday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
